title: Quantitative ANC performance and latency acceptance are absent
description: The product requires low-latency real-time FxLMS and mentions a preliminary band in the architecture figure, but no complete attenuation, phase, latency or acoustic acceptance mask is frozen. This constrains architecture and feasibility claims.

evidence.note: No complete quantitative ANC acceptance mask is given.

R3 disposition: The R3 bounded prototype envelope is four-in/two-out at 96 kHz with an exploratory 80?800-Hz sweep. No manufacturer source or owner message supplies a quantified attenuation/latency acceptance mask; final product performance remains a physical/acoustic validation gate, so R3 claims no performance pass. Earlier R1 criterion remains in repository history. Prior R1 status=open, blocker=R3, closure criterion: Product owner and controls/acoustic lead approve a measurable operating band, attenuation/latency target or a clearly bounded prototype envelope, plus conditions and measurement method before R3 architecture freeze; physical performance remains unproven until EVT.
R4 preflight reviewed this finding. External physical/acoustic/mechanical closure remains phase-scoped; R4 did not close it.

closure_criterion: Owner and controls/acoustic lead approve measured ANC operating band, attenuation/latency limits and method before R12 physical performance qualification; R4 must retain a latency budget and ability to measure it.
resolved_by: R3 architecture disposition; later closure required
resolution: The R3 bounded prototype envelope is four-in/two-out at 96 kHz with an exploratory 80?800-Hz sweep. No manufacturer source or owner message supplies a quantified attenuation/latency acceptance mask; final product performance remains a physical/acoustic validation gate, so R3 claims no performance pass.
